expectations.text: States the sunset periods for the 3DS SDK, SPoC and CPoC standards ended October 31, 2026
expectations.evidence: the sunset periods for the PCI SPoC and CPoC standards ended on October 31, 2026... The same date applied to the PCI 3DS SDK standard.

expectations.text: States no new submissions are accepted under those standards
expectations.evidence: No new submissions are accepted under either standard... Nothing new will be accepted under SPoC or CPoC.

expectations.text: States existing accepted or listed solutions keep their normal lifecycle treatment
expectations.evidence: It did not remove existing listings. Existing listings keep their normal lifecycle, so your current SPoC solution is not suddenly invalid.

expectations.text: Identifies MPoC as the successor for SPoC and CPoC
expectations.evidence: MPoC is the successor to both, and any new COTS-based solution should be an MPoC solution.

expectations.text: Notes 3DS SDK functionality is being folded into the Secure Software Standard
expectations.evidence: The same date applied to the PCI 3DS SDK standard. Its functionality is being folded into the Secure Software Standard.
